summary: AI Platform Engineer with production experience building LLM-powered systems, RAG pipelines, and real-time AI data platforms at scale. Built hybrid search (BM25 + vector embeddings), LLM-driven documentation pipelines for 6,500+ tables, and production tool-calling APIs — all serving sub-200ms. Strong foundation in distributed systems (Kafka, Flink) and algorithms (LeetCode 1844, top 6\%). %-----------EDUCATION-----------

experiences.title: Swiggy — Data Platform Engineering
bullets: Built a hybrid search system combining BM25 keyword matching + 1024-dim dense vector embeddings with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, achieving 82\% precision@5; deployed as a production API with 6 tool-calling endpoints at sub-200ms p95 latency.

Engineered an LLM-powered documentation pipeline generating structured metadata for 6,500+ warehouse tables — context compression, self-repair JSON parsing (99.5\% success), and multi-source enrichment (code search, usage analytics, lineage graphs).

Achieved 10x pipeline throughput by replacing 60,000 sequential queries with 6 bulk-prefetch batch queries; parallelized across 15 workers with thread-safe state management and fingerprint-based change detection to skip unchanged tables.

Architected a real-time CDC streaming pipeline using Debezium, Kafka, and Apache Flink — processing millions of change events daily with PII masking, schema evolution handling, and Insert/Update/Delete routing across production tables.

Shipped Grafana monitoring \& alerting for AI pipeline health, embedding quality drift, and search latency — reducing incident detection from hours to minutes; delivered 2 merged PRs for connector testing and stream transformation logic.

experiences.title: Drdot — Product Engineering
bullets: Built and deployed 15+ RESTful APIs (Node.js, Express.js) handling authentication, CRUD, and real-time data serving; improved API throughput by 50\% through connection pooling and query optimization.

Achieved 85\% code coverage with Jest unit tests and Postman integration suites; implemented JWT auth with role-based access control, rate limiting, and input sanitization preventing OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.

experiences.title: IIIT Kottayam — Under Prof. Dr. Bhanu Chander
bullets: Published peer-reviewed paper on CNN-based classification achieving 90.5\% accuracy; applied structured pruning + INT8 quantization reducing inference latency by 3.2x for edge deployment on resource-constrained devices.
